briefing: Manifest first: one transporter hull, one escort run, one salvage sweep, one kill order. This is Colonel {PATRON}, state guard, out of {HERE}. You carry the manifest to the target, you see the transporter home, and if it burns, you scoop what falls from it.
Then you find the Asp that hunts it and you put it down, however it runs. The state pays on delivery, not on excuses. Fail me once and the contract ends there.

manifest.arrive: Take the manifest to {TARGET}. Fee on delivery: {PAY}.
manifest.fail: Manifest lost before {TARGET}. No fee earned.

guard.arrive: See the transporter into station range at {TARGET}. {PAY} on arrival.

wreck.arrive: Scoop the transporter's cargo adrift at {TARGET}. {PAY} on recovery.

purge.arrive: Destroy the Asp, last seen at {TARGET}. {PAY} on kill.
purge.success: Asp accounted for near {TARGET}. {PAY} paid in full.
purge.fail: Asp still loose near {TARGET}. Contract fails.

dossier.lead: Colonel {PATRON} wants a word, docked at {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Word travels that a state guard colonel named {PATRON} hires pilots for a manifest run out of {WORLD}.
rumour.near: {PATRON} has docked at {WORLD} and wants you for the manifest contract.

dossier.news: State guard business waits for a pilot at {WORLD}; ask the docking officer for {PATRON}.
dossier.title: The Colonel's Manifest

closing.complete: By day {DAY} the Asp was accounted for and the contract closed at {WORLD}.
closing.fail: By day {DAY} the contract collapsed and the colonel's orders went unanswered at {WORLD}.

manifest.success: On day {DAY} she delivered the manifest to {WORLD}.
manifest.failed: On day {DAY} the manifest never reached {WORLD}, and the contract died.
